snippet.description:
When encountering a class-17 nebula a repressed memory triggers in Tuvok, a life-threatening condition for Vulcans, one that requires the help of a family member to mind-meld with the one inflicted. Captain Janeway, as the closest thing to a trusted family member, agrees to mind-meld with Tuvok who relives  his experiences aboard the USS Excelsior, under the command of Captain Sulu (events which would have taken place in the time Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country, from 1991). 

Captain Sulu notes Ensign Tuvok's objections to go against regulations, but explains to him there's more to being on a bridge than following orders and regulations. The scene highlights how what is law isn't always right and that a sense of community and serving and helping one another is more important to the future than the acquisition of wealth and status

snippet.title: The Brick Tax That Made Bricks Huge 😳
snippet.description:
In 1784 Britain needed money after losing the American War of Independence, so Parliament put a tax on bricks: makers paid duty on every thousand bricks they fired. Brickmakers answered by making their bricks bigger, so a wall needed fewer of them and paid less tax (Joseph Wilkes's oversized "Gobs" at Measham are the famous example). The government hit back: from 1801 to 1803, any brick bigger than 10 × 5 × 3 inches paid double duty. Some builders gave up on brick and built in timber, then hid the wood behind "mathematical tiles": clay tiles nailed onto battens and pointed with mortar so they look exactly like brickwork. Houses faced with them still stand in Brighton, Lewes and other towns in the south of England, and most people walk past without noticing. The brick tax was repealed in 1850.

Sources: Wikipedia, "Brick tax"; Robin Lucas, "The tax on bricks and tiles, 1784–1850" (Construction History); Scottish Brick History notes on the brick duty.

مشهد يعكس قوة المرأة العاقلة وكيفية احتواء الأزمات بالحكمة والكرامة وإعادة الزوج لوعيه قبل فوات الأوان.

بطولة: محمد كمال | هيا أحمد

لو كنتِ مكان الزوجة، هل هتقدري تتصرفي بنفس الهدوء والحكمة دي؟ وهل رد فعلها ده هيخلي الزوج يتغير فعلاً؟ شاركونا آراءكم في التعليقات! 👇

1️⃣ اضغط إعجاب (👍) ليصل المشهد لأكبر عدد من الناس.

الخيانة الزوجية، كشف خيانة الزوج، رد فعل الزوجة، حكمة الزوجة، احتواء المشاكل الزوجية، دراما اجتماعية، قصص واقعية، محمد كمال، هيا أحمد، نصائح للمتزوجين، مشهد مؤثر، حالات واتس اب حزينة.

snippet.title: Nadie va a usar la 10 de la Selección 😳 #SelecciónArgentina #messi
snippet.description: Contra Uruguay y Costa Rica nadie va a usar la 10 de la Selección Argentina: la AFA decidió dejar vacía la camiseta de Messi en los amistosos de noviembre, porque en los amistosos la FIFA no exige numeración consecutiva. En las Eliminatorias de 2027 alguien la va a tener que heredar. Sin Messi ya la usó Franco Mastantuono, contra Ecuador en Guayaquil. Los candidatos: Nico Paz, Mastantuono, Mac Allister y Enzo Fernández. ¿Quién la tiene que heredar?
